scope: Proposition 4.3 (Orbit generation) of the manuscript “Rationality of the Canonical Unramified Arthur Filtration” (preprints/Rationality-of-the-Canonical-Unramified-Arthur-Filtration-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 014 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 eaf8e38720714e23), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The objects MP , for simple P ∈ Ee, generate the compact category supported on J.e in an open where it is closed. Here “generate” allows finite cones, shifts and summands. The category Ee is semisimple.
